description: This file defines an in-memory implementation of the NotesRepository interface for managing notes within an application. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, along with initial mock data seeding.

classes.name: InMemoryNotesRepository
classes.description: An implementation of NotesRepository that stores notes in memory, suitable for development and testing purposes.

methods.name: InMemoryNotesRepository
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the in-memory store with seed data.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Stores a new note in the in-memory repository.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a note by its ID.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Clears all notes from the repository.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes, optionally filtered by a search query.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a note by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note and refreshes its 'updatedAt' timestamp.
